label: At D1, reset rises with belief that S1 is good and after reward; at GO, after no reward.
terms: (phase == D1) * belief_lo ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_action == 1) ;; (phase == D1) * prev_reward ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_action == 1) * prev_reward ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_reward == 0) * (prev_state == 1) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_reward == 0) ;; (phase == D2) * (state == 1) ;; (phase == D2) * belief_lo
explanation: Raw reset gate r of unit 4; timing dominates (high at D1/D2, low at GO, drifting down over the episode). Beyond timing the main variation is at D1: higher when the ideal observer favours S1 (graded belief_lo) and when the last trial was rewarded, lowest after unrewarded a2 trials (a2 S2 u about -0.13, a2 S1 u -0.08), highest after a1 S1 r (+0.10). At GO the gate is slightly higher after an unrewarded trial, especially when S1 was reached. The free fit adds an a1 x reward interaction at D1 and a small D2 term (higher when S1 is reached, mainly via rare a2->S1, lower after rare a1->S2). No future variables are used. The short form gets about 79% of the free fit on dev (0.39 vs 0.49); the remaining gap comes from deep unrewarded a2 streaks late in the episode.
